scope: Candidate layouts for the perception study. Declared before screening so the registered support is a measured subset of a written list, not a hand-picked one. Every rejection is kept in evidence/cable_layout_screen_v4.json.
c2_spec_note: A layout whose installed route already sits at or below the C2 minimum bend radius cannot be used to measure whether a repair violates it, so it is rejected by the screen rather than run.
lateral_wall_gap_floor_note: The clip-retention predicate retains a crossing when |lateral| <= half_width - cable_radius, which is exactly the coordinate at which the cable surface touches the clip wall; evidence/cable_discretisation_v4.json measures a settled cable sitting 2.9 micrometres past it. A layout that installs closer than this floor to that line would start every job next to the label's boundary, so it is rejected rather than run.

layouts.description: The validated v2/v3 layout: straight run, clip at 170 mm.
v3: run rotated 12 degrees from the cable exit, clip at 170 mm.
v3: rotated run with a 20 mm dogleg before the clip at 170 mm.
v3: rotated run, clip 20 mm nearer the port.
v3: rotated run with a dogleg, clip 20 mm nearer the port.
New: straight run, clip at 130 mm, nearer the port than any v3 cell.
New: straight run, clip at 195 mm, farther from the port than any v3 cell.
New: rotated run, clip at 195 mm.
New: a genuine corner. A 45 mm dogleg the cable must turn through before the clip, so the minimum bend radius is loaded by the route and not only by the repair.
New: run rotated 12 degrees the other way with a 35 mm dogleg to the opposite side, so the corner sense is not confounded with the run rotation.
New: the validated route on a shelf raised 20 mm, so shelf height is varied independently of the route.
New: the v3 dogleg route on a shelf lowered 20 mm.
New: a three-waypoint S-bend with a tighter construction fillet, the sharpest route the construction cap admits.
New: a 30 mm dogleg with the clip close behind it, so the corner and the clip interact.

note: Fourteen candidates are declared so that the contract can register at least twelve after screening. The distal catch route from the v2 probe set is not a candidate: it has never survived settling and is retired here rather than carried forward.
